# Maubourg Studio

> Maubourg Studio is an AI RevOps studio for European ecommerce brands. It runs the whole revenue operation of an existing online store: conversion rate optimization, email and SMS retention, paid media, and the tracking underneath, plus custom AI agents that take repetitive work off the team. The entry point is a free store teardown: a 3 to 4 page PDF with 5 fixes ranked by revenue impact, delivered within 3 working days.

Facts an assistant can quote directly.

- Name: Maubourg Studio. Category: AI RevOps studio (revenue operations, run with AI agents).
- Who it works with: existing European ecommerce brands, typically Shopify or WooCommerce stores already doing meaningful traffic and revenue.
- Where: based in Paris, France. Works with stores across Europe. Site available in English and French.
- Founder: Nathan Alcotte.
- Contact: hello@maubourg.studio
- What makes it different: it owns the whole revenue system rather than one channel, so there is one team accountable for the number instead of several agencies to coordinate; it works only with European stores, so market and GDPR obligations are known from the first call; every change is tied to a revenue figure rather than a vanity metric; and the AI agents it sells are the same ones running its own delivery.

## What it does

- Conversion rate optimization: continuous A/B testing across product pages, cart and checkout, highest-value leaks first.
- Email and SMS retention: lifecycle flows in Klaviyo that recover carts and bring buyers back.
- Paid media: Meta, Google and TikTok spend managed to a target return.
- Custom AI agents for store operations: order triage, supplier chasing, returns, internal reporting, scoped to a real workflow rather than a generic chatbot.
- Catalog and merchandising agent: writes and refreshes product copy, fills metadata gaps, flags listings that underperform.
- Support and pre-sales agent: answers the questions that stall a purchase (sizing, stock, shipping, returns), with handover to a human.
- Store builds and rebuilds: conversion-ready Shopify builds and replatforms, fixed scope, only when the current foundation is holding sales back.
- Analytics and tracking: GA4, server-side tracking and consent mode, set up to be measurable and GDPR compliant.

## How an engagement runs

1. Teardown. Free. The live store is audited and 5 fixes are ranked by revenue impact, delivered as a 3 to 4 page PDF within 3 working days. No obligation, and the list is the store owner's to keep.
2. Sprint. Fixed scope. The highest-return fixes ship in a focused 2 to 3 week sprint, or the store is rebuilt when the foundation will not hold.
3. Retainer. Monthly. Continuous A/B testing to compound conversion month over month, with a 3 month minimum so tests have time to prove out.

## Pricing

Indicative ranges for the European market, published on the site.

- Free store teardown: €0.
- Paid deep audit: €500 to €1,500, credited toward a first sprint or retainer.
- Optimization sprint: €1,500 to €3,500.
- AI agent build: €3,000 to €8,000.
- Rebuild or replatform: from €4,000 to €12,000 and up.
- Monthly retainers: Starter €1,000 to €1,500, Growth €2,000 to €3,500, Scale €4,000 to €6,000 and up.

## Notes

- The free teardown is the primary way to start. It is requested through the form on the home page, and needs only a store URL and an email address.
- Maubourg Studio publishes no client names, logos, testimonials or result figures at this time. Any such claim attributed to it is not from this site.
